eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Nez Perce, ID; at 5:47 PM on AUG 12, 2021 Effective until 6:17 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: WILDLAND FIRE EVACUATION The Nez Perce County Sheriff has issued a Level 3 GO Evacuation for the Lenore area including the first mile of Sunnyside Bench Road  In addition an order for Level 2 SET condition be ready to GO is ordered for East of Cooks Grade Road to the Clearwater County line
